summary_zh: Orkas 是开源（MIT）、本地优先的桌面多智能体应用。Commander 把目标拆成待办，调度 16 个内置专业智能体，并协同 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等命令行智能体，可用项目、定时自动化与连接器持续推进任务，成果交由用户审核。
audience_zh: 适合希望以智能体团队而非单一助手推进跨天工作的 macOS/Windows 桌面用户，如市场内容、电商运营、研究与报告、开发与办公文档等场景；也适合重视数据本地保存、想接入自有模型密钥或本地端点的使用者。

evidence.quote: Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first AI team for your desktop: a Commander turns your goal into to-dos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes, with projects, scheduled automations and connectors. self, and **scheduled automations** repeat routine work hourly, daily, weekly or monthly. All your data stays on your computer, and finished work comes back for your review — so you can trust Orkas with the ongoing work of your business.
